ItemID: NA; Title: Fire TV Stick with Alexa Voice Remote, streaming media player - Previous Generation; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I already have a Fire TV Stick 4K and a Fire TV television, so this older stick adds little.

ItemID: NA; Title: Echo (2nd Generation) - Smart speaker with Alexa and Dolby processing - Charcoal Fabric; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Alexa fits my home setup, but I would choose the smaller Echo Dot this time because voice control is my main interest.
ItemID: NA; Title: Amazon Fire TV - 1st Generation; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: This older device would be redundant alongside my existing Fire TV equipment.

ItemID: NA; Title: Fire 7 tablet, 7" display, 16 GB, (2019 release), Black; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I have no clear need for another screen when my recent purchases center on television viewing and cameras.
